{{Top|canon=Fifteen Moons Casino and Hotel}}
The '''Fifteen Moons Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. They offered games of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], [[fan-tan]], [[crack-loo]], and [[pitch-and-toss]]. The fan-tan tables in the casino were capable of dispensing new drinks for the players.<ref name="Scoundrel">''[[Scoundrel's Luck]]''</ref>
